snippet.title: SKROLL - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
SKROLL is a survival roguelike where your own brain is your worst enemy. It wakes you up every day with the same demand: reach your dopamine quota or suffer the consequences. Your tool: the phone. Your only task: scroll endlessly to satisfy its increasingly impossible demands.

There is no escape. Each cycle, the demands increase. Your brain wants more. Always more. And you're just the slave holding the phone, scrolling desperately as your battery drains, your sleep evaporates, and your sanity crumbles.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4224290/SKROLL/

Developer: Cyclops Games
